## Developer problem

What task is difficult today? Include agent host/platform if relevant.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the smallest useful outcome and a concrete public/disposable example.
How would we verify it works? What should remain explicitly unknown?

## Alternatives and scope

What existing scan/triage/approval/fix/verify step falls short? Avoid assuming
automatic source-edit, authentication, Git publication or full-site coverage.

Do not include credentials, private source, browser profiles or personal data.
